title: Let grace settle what you cannot
summary: The Perfect Guru's forgiveness is not another self-improvement task; it widens into Bani, Naam, and peace shared beyond you.
takeaway: Let forgiven peace become praise before self-scrutiny returns.
lifeApplication: When you start auditing yourself again, pause long enough to sing one line of Bani and receive the peace already being given.

source.shortMeaning: The Perfect Guru's forgiveness completes what self-repair cannot finish.
source.lifeApplication: Let one line of Bani carry you from self-review into received peace.

evidence.coreClaim: The Perfect Guru's forgiveness completes what self-repair cannot finish.
evidence.turn: Forgiveness becomes lasting peace as it moves the mouth toward Bani and the mind toward Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you start auditing yourself again, pause long enough to sing one line of Bani and receive the peace already being given.
